name: Chartered Companies
description: Empires charter trading companies to settle distant worlds. A company is a sub-empire of its founder's race, bound by a Subjugated Dominion or Protectorate treaty, and pays its founder a tariff on its sales. Charters expire and can be renewed, released or nationalised; AI empires charter rival companies.
